brief.summary: The Maelstrom intensities are now four exclusive buckets (Garrett, 2026-11-16): 1 Beginner (6 games), 2 Great (Skim Race only), 3 Good (7), 4 Floor (69). Every arcade card (83) is in exactly one. Merged in #2030.
decisions: A run at intensity N deals ONLY tier N's games (was cumulative 1..N); an empty bucket falls back to the whole queue.
Tiers are placed by Tools/Build/maelstrom_tiers.py from measured human flights/launches (bugledger), git history and sign-offs; Garrett's examples are verdicts: Scarab Rally 1, Skim Race 2, Joust 3.
Cleave is held in the Floor by your run's host-freeze finding (B45).
open: Great holds one game, so a ceiling-2 Maelstrom deals only Skim Race; Garrett decides whether a second belongs there
your finding 4: the guest never learns the intensity ceiling - with tiers it now also shows the guest the wrong bucket's pool line

steps: Arcade -> Maelstrom at intensity 1: rounds deal only Scarab Rally, Slingshot, Scarab Scramble, Scurry, Waystation, Bloomrush; hub line '6 of 83 modes, intensity 1'
Intensity 4: a Floor round on a newer hull (Tiger Moth, Angler, Orca) loads, AI seats fly or sit, Continue returns to the hub
Move a game: python3 Tools/Build/maelstrom_tiers.py set <game> <1-4> --by <you>, then --write; re-place everything after playtests: maelstrom_tiers.py measure
